title: UneceIllness
description: A WHO MDH (Maritime Declaration of Health) reported illness or disease for an onboard person.

caseDispositionCode.description: A code specifying a case disposition of this MDH illness.

comment.description: A comment, expressed as text for this MDH illness.

evacuationLocation.description: A logistics evacuation location for this MDH illness.

healthStatusCode.description: A code specifying a health status of this MDH illness.

healthStatusReportedIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not the health status has been reported for this MDH illness.

nature.description: A nature, expressed as text, of this MDH illness.

symptomOnsetDateTime.description: A symptom onset date, time, date time or other date time value for this MDH illness.

treatment.description: A treatment, expressed as text, for this MDH illness.
